description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity `FragmentDialogOrActivity` that manages a UI with embedded fragments and dialog fragments. It includes logic for creating and displaying a dialog fragment, and defines an internal static class `MyDialogFragment` which inflates a layout and displays text.

classes.name: FragmentDialogOrActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that embeds a dialog fragment and displays it upon button click.

classes.name: MyDialogFragment
classes.description: A static inner class extending DialogFragment, inflates a layout and displays a text message.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, adds dialog fragment, and sets button click listener.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Creates and shows an instance of MyDialogFragment as a dialog.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method for creating a new instance of MyDialogFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for MyDialogFragment and sets some text.
